summary: Iteration 5 — both bugs from iteration_4 are FIXED. Backend pytest now 33/33 PASS (was 31/33) on /app/backend/tests/test_portal_api.py, including TestI4GradeReference.test_mtech_grade_table_mtech_reference (M.Tech grade table — 'Outstanding/Excellent/Pass/Absent' present) and TestI4GsPdf.test_gs_no_slno_no_provisional_has_grade_sheet (Director on every sampled student page). Smoke confirmed via direct PDF inspection: B.Tech excel-only upload produces 55-page GS where Director appears on pages 1–54 (54/55) and the appendix (page 55) contains the B.Tech grade reference (D+/E+/P present, 'Outstanding' absent); M.Tech excel-only upload produces 55-page GS where Director appears on pages 1–54 and appendix contains M.Tech ordinance labels (Outstanding/Excellent/Pass/Absent) with NO 'D+'/'E+'. Per-spec student pages 1, 5, 50, last-1 all carry Director on both PDFs. TC PDF still A3 portrait (842x1191pt), totals row populated, 'UTU' enrollment + 'Director' + 'GBPIET' present in signature row. Frontend /student/results heading verified live as exact 'Results' (no 'Provisional Results' anywhere on page).
critical_code_review_comments: processor.program_short normalisation (strip dots/spaces, upper-case, then map MTECH/MASTER->M. TECH, BTECH/BACHELOR->B. TECH, MCA->MCA) now correctly drives _grade_table_for_program — verified end-to-end via M.Tech excel-only upload producing M.Tech ordinance grade table.

GS PDF appendix-page strategy works: grade reference is now rendered ONCE at the end of the GS document on a dedicated final page; per-student pages no longer overflow, and the signature row (Prepared by / Checked by / Director / Examination Controller) wrapped in KeepTogether appears on every student page (54/55 pages have 'Director', last is appendix). This also keeps GS file size predictable.
Frontend StudentResults.jsx now renders 'Results' heading consistent with PDF title 'GRADE SHEET' (Provisional dropped both places).
TC PDF unchanged — A3 portrait, totals, enrollment column populated; nothing regressed.

Suggestion (low priority): TestI4GsPdf.test_gs_no_slno_no_provisional_has_grade_sheet samples up to 3 pages (0, 50, 106). The 55-page actual output triggers only [0, 50] today. Consider expanding sampling to fixed ratios (10%, 50%, 90%, last_student=n-2) for stronger regression coverage now that appendix-page is canonical.

rca of the issue: Both iteration_4 bugs resolved.
